== Printed 2PG game text (16 November 2026) ==
The article and face now use the wording from a photograph of the printed ESB Two-Player card, which differs from the Hoth Limited printing. Light Side: "During your move phase, you may move (for free) between here and Mountains." Dark Side: "If Main Power Generators on table, Force drain -1 here." The Limited sides were also reversed in the earlier article text; both the Limited and 2PG prints put the move text on the Light Side and the Force drain text on the Dark Side. The difference is noted on the article. Refs [[swccg-guild/work#276]].
